scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && node -e "const url=process.env.DIRECT_URL||process.env.DATABASE_URL||process.env.POSTGRES_URL||process.env.POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING; if(url && !url.includes('HOST')){ console.log('Executando prisma migrate deploy...'); require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma migrate deploy', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { console.log('Sem banco configurado: pulando migrate deploy.'); }" && next build
